fixes.en: Rather than live with regret, go for it, even if you're smashed to pieces!
fixes.why: Misread: the source says 'rather than regret it, go all in and shatter'; the old line ('If you're going to regret it...') reversed the logic.

fixes.en: Mission this, mission that! Is that all you ever think about?!
fixes.why: Misread: 'is that all you have' means the listener cares about nothing but the mission; 'Is that all you've got?!' reads as a taunt about strength.
Duplicate title: row 998 (loanword 'technician') is already 'Technician'; this one is the native word for a technique-focused style, so two shop titles showed the same English.
Pair with row 966 'Strongest Bride' (Max/Milia wedding titles, same source wording); the mismatched 'The Mightiest Groom' broke the pairing.
